system.description:
You also begin play with a companion of your choice from the following list: @UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.classes.Item.aWEiTX6H3VbNG4qr]{Acolyte}, @UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.classes.Item.fO3crpeDnzulWUbY]{Construct}, @UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.classes.Item.gKWZHZxuXJ506rRD]{Cultist}, @UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.classes.Item.oAVdsZYjktuHcV9d]{Fey}, @UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.classes.Item.cF38Q81ri8Ju33cj]{Hedge Wizard}, @UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.classes.Item.W9dqdzARXwnFHBym]{Hunter}, @UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.classes.Item.aB84Vfe7nD68s1Mr]{Mage}, @UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.classes.Item.2yhY8u4TnB4Ci1Xb]{Scoundrel}, @UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.classes.Item.YlLC9rPg8aGgEUuV]{Squire}, or @UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.classes.Item.0xzfTvjEWDJBdtbG]{Undead}. The attributes of each are presented at the end of the Sentinel class entry.

Your companion shares your proficiency bonus and acts either immediately before or after you on your initiative count in combat, your choice each round. Your companion will follow your orders to the best of their ability on their turn, using their action, bonus action, and movement as you see fit, as well as any reactions.

Replacing a Companion

If your companion dies, they can be restored to life through normal means (@UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.9zhsri19dkhm9mcf]{Raise Dead}, for example). But if you choose not to revive your companion, or choose to release your companion, you must spend 8 hours recruiting a new companion in a safe haven. Your former companion loses all Sentinel class benefits that you would normally grant them, and your new companion gains them after the training session.

Companion Advancement

Your companion gains hit dice and abilities as presented by the @UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.class-features.Item.bgAUuevvntBbp5FZ]{Field Training} class feature. However, any time you would gain an Ability Score Increase class feature from any source, you also increase one of your companion’s attributes by 1. This applies retroactively to new companions or in cases of multiclassing.
